subject: Payment routing and billing cutover for TrustCorp carve-out
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@trustcorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: TrustCorp Payables <payables@trustcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Payment routing and billing cutover for TrustCorp carve-out

Hi Rishi,

Quick note from finance at TrustCorp — as part of the planned carve-out, invoices for the divested business (previously billed to TrustCorp Operations) need to be routed to the new holding entity: TrustCorp Special Holdings, Inc. Effective date requested: 2028-01-01.

New remit details:
- Company: TrustCorp Special Holdings, Inc.
- Remit: AP Team, 400 Market St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Email for e-invoicing: payables@trustcorp.com
- Tax ID: 93-2145567 (new VAT/TIN to be used for US and EU invoices)

Can you confirm what you need from us to make this change on your side? We can provide a purchase order, a signed amendment, and a short vendor setup form. Also please advise whether pending invoices for December should be re-routed or paid to the original entity and then re-invoiced.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our migration timeline is tight.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Finance (Carve-outs)
TrustCorp
[Attachment: TrustCorp_Remit_Details.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@trustcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment routing and billing cutover for TrustCorp carve-out

Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the remit sheet. 

We can make this move effective 2028-01-01. To proceed cleanly we will need:
1) A signed billing amendment that names TrustCorp Special Holdings, Inc. as the billed-to / remit-to entity (DocuSign is fine).
2) A Purchase Order number for recurring invoices (if you use one).
3) Confirmation on whether you want us to re-route December invoices or issue credit/rebill after the cutover.

Internal next steps: I have looped in Laura (finance) for tax/VAT handling and Marissa (contracts) to prepare an amendment template and DocuSign envelope. Once we have the signed amendment and PO we will:
- update our billing system and ledger tag for TrustCorp Special Holdings
- update remit and EFT/ACH instructions if provided
- set the first invoice with new remit to be the Jan 1 billing run (or earlier if you request)

I will also provide a support ticket id so our billing ops can track the switchover.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Payment routing and billing cutover for TrustCorp carve-out (internal)

Laura / Marissa —
Forwarding TrustCorp's remit change request. High level asks for us:
- Marissa: draft a short amendment that changes billed entity and adds the remit address, effective 2028-01-01. Please include a clause about tax handling and legacy invoice redirection option (credit/rebill). Create a DocuSign envelope and mark me as approver.
- Laura: confirm whether the new Tax ID (93-2145567) requires any changes to our EU tax treatment or invoicing format. If there are VAT implications, call them out and I will coordinate with TrustCorp for EUTAX forms.

Please also confirm the ledger tag to use for the new TrustCorp Special Holdings account so ops can start routing once we have sign-off. We may need a short one-off journal entry for December if they want December re-routed.

I will handle external comms and get the PO if they have one.

Thanks — R

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Lena / Payables team —
Thanks, Ethan — received the signed amendment and sample invoice. Marissa prepared the DocuSign envelope and legal has recorded the amendment in CLM. Laura confirmed tax/VAT treatment (no UK VAT registration required for the new entity; US tax id recorded).

Summary of actions we completed:
- Legal: amendment executed and uploaded (CLM ID: CLM-2027-TC-88).
- Finance: ledger tag created (TAG: TC_SP_HLDGS).
- Billing ops: remit address and payables email added to our billing system and set as active for invoices dated 2028-01-01 and later.
- Pending invoices dated before 2028-01-01 will remain billed to TrustCorp Operations and should be paid under the existing flow; we will issue credits and rebill only if you request it explicitly.

DocuSign / record links: https://docusign.com/TC/Envelope/12345 — please keep for your records.

Next steps for accounts payable: please confirm the PO number (if any) to include on recurring invoices — otherwise we will include the TrustCorp Special Holdings billing reference and your payables email.

If everything looks good, I will close the ops ticket and schedule a one-hour post-cutover check on 2028-01-15 to verify remittance flow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
